subject: reasoning
question: Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, K, L and O, are kept one over the other, but not necessarily in the same order. Only D is kept above C. Only L is kept between C and B. Only A is kept below K. How many boxes are kept between O and A?
solution:
Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, K, L and O, are kept one over the other, but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only D is kept above C.
 
• Only L is kept between C and B.
 
• Only A is kept below K

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
L

 
 
 

 
 
B

 
 
 

 
 
O

 
 
 

 
 
K

 
 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
